title: Where the Chosen Path Learns It Was Always the Same

features.name: fork junction marker
features.desc-on-touch: this stone marks where the road divides. carved into it are two arrows pointing the same way. the hand that carved it knew something the walker doesn't.

features.name: the unchosen path monument
features.desc-on-touch: someone built a cairn for the route they didn't take. the stones are worn smooth from touching. you can feel the person who made this choice.

features.name: mile-marker convergence
features.desc-on-touch: both paths' mile markers say the same distance to the same destination. the town knew you were coming long before you chose.

features.name: walkers' testimonies
features.desc-on-touch: scratches and names carved into trees line both routes. every person who chose left their mark the same way. the ridge remembers them identically.

features.name: the viewpoint both see
features.desc-on-touch: at the highest point, both paths converge. from here the view is identical, and you realize you could have chosen either and arrived at the same moment.

features.name: the choice stone embedded
features.desc-on-touch: worn and heavy. you hold it and feel that choosing has already happened. you're just walking toward your own decision.

inscription: both paths lead here; the ridge chose for you before you chose; the unchosen way grows just as deep; choice is remembering what was always true

file.name: Identical_Route_Logs_1995_2019.txt
file.note: field journals from different walkers, decades apart. corrupted to read: 'I chose the left path. I chose the right path. We both arrived at the same time. Neither of us chose.'

reverie.title: REVERIE — on the ridge where choice dissolves
narr: you both stand at the fork. she's looking down
the left path; you're looking down the right. you
reach out your hand at the same time and take
the center. 'i thought we were supposed to choose'
she says. 'we did,' you say. 'we chose to walk together.'
the ridge shifts beneath you. both paths forget.

exits.label: back along the unchosen path, deeper into your actual choice
where direction itself surrenders to meaning
NEW: into the place where choosing becomes echo
downward where the two paths were always one
